geometryNotes.bounds: Inclusive alpha>=128 main connected-component bounds [x,y,width,height], measured on native PNG bytes. sourceRect is recommended [x,y,width,height] for canvas drawImage and CSS sprite cropping. Rectangle width/height need not be equal; retain source aspect ratio.
geometryNotes.nativeAlpha: All source PNGs have genuine transparency. Bodies are generally alpha252 rather than255. Painted RGB survives underneath alpha0, so RGB-only image viewers show a misleading backdrop. Use RGBA rendering.
geometryNotes.atlasGrid: 3 columns by2 rows; row-major cell0-4 are creatures, cell5 has no sixth creature. Native 2k output is2048×1360. Some outlines cross nominal grid boundaries; use species sourceRect overrides to preserve ears, antlers, tails and toes. Faint ambient alpha below32 may cross adjacent cells.
geometryNotes.preservation: Downloaded PNGs are unchanged byte-for-byte. No raster crop, recolor or alpha edits applied.
geometryNotes.visualQA: All25 original species verified in requested order, facing right, complete full bodies visible. Revised atlases3 and4 implement user's cute-to-cool-to-aggressive direction. Lasso shows complete coiled golden rope. Last grid cell contains no extra creature; faint source glow and slight boundary overflow are excluded by custom source rectangles.
geometryNotes.tightBoundary: In atlas5 bear/kirin bounding boxes meet at x1379; bear sourceRect ends at1379 and kirin starts there. The split preserves both solid silhouettes; a single antialiased edge column can touch this seam.
